# .github/autonomy/deny.txt — anything matching here makes the PR `human`.
#
# Owner: Jon. Read by scripts/autonomy_class.py from the BASE branch only.
# Spec: AGENTIC-L5-PLAN v1.2.1 §2 R1 and review carry-forwards C1-C3.
#
# DENY WINS over allow.txt. This list is NOT exhaustive by design: anything
# not in allow.txt is already `human`. These lines exist so that (a) a later
# widening of allow.txt cannot silently admit a sensitive path, and (b) the
# sensitive files INSIDE allowed directories are carved out by name.
#
# LINE FORMS
#   <glob>              path glob. Matched CASE-INSENSITIVELY against the
#                       changed file's path AND, for renames/copies, its
#                       previous path.
#   content: <regex>    Python regex, case-insensitive, searched in the WHOLE
#                       head version of every changed file — not just the
#                       added lines (C2). Also searched in the NFKC-normalised
#                       text, so full-width lookalikes match too.
#   content-cs: <regex> same, case-sensitive (for SQL keywords etc. that would
#                       otherwise fire on ordinary UI copy).
#   import: <glob>      an import target. Every import/export-from/@import in
#                       a changed file is resolved (`@/` -> apps/web/src/,
#                       relative paths against the file's directory) and
#                       matched against these globs; bare package names are
#                       matched as written (C1).
# Glob syntax is the same as allow.txt. An unknown `xxx:` prefix or an invalid
# regex makes the checker fail, and a failed checker posts `human`.

# ── Whole-file content patterns (C2) ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Money (plan R1 list).
content: stripe
content: /api/billing
content: /api/entitlements
content: checkout
content: entitlement
content: allowance
content: credit
content: \[billing\]
# Network: any fetch, and the other ways to reach the network.
content: \bfetch\s*\(
content: XMLHttpRequest
content: sendBeacon
content: \bWebSocket\b
content: \bEventSource\b
content: /api/auth
# A URL literal to any host (new hosts) except the SVG namespace.
content: \bhttps?://(?!www\.w3\.org/)
# Secrets and environment.
content: process\.env
content: import\.meta\.env
content: service[_-]?role
content: SUPABASE_
content: \bsk_(live|test)_
content: \bwhsec_
content: api[_-]?key
content: secret
content: \bsupabase\b
content: document\.cookie
# Code execution and the usual obfuscations of the above.
content: \beval\s*\(
content: \bnew\s+Function\b
content: \bFunction\s*\(
content: child_process
content: \brequire\s*\(
content: \bimport\s*\(
content: \bglobalThis\b
content: \b(window|self|global)\s*\[
content: \bReflect\.
content: \batob\s*\(
content: fromCharCode
content: \\u\{?[0-9a-f]{2,}
content: \\x[0-9a-f]{2}
# HTML injection.
content: dangerouslySetInnerHTML
content: \binnerHTML\b
content: \bouterHTML\b
content: <script
content: javascript:
# SQL (upper-case keywords only; lower-case "select a section" is UI copy).
content-cs: \b(SELECT|INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM|DROP|ALTER TABLE|CREATE TABLE|CREATE POLICY|GRANT|REVOKE|TRUNCATE)\b
content: \.rpc\s*\(
content: \bsql`
